title: Replenishment orders the right items in the right quantities
requirement: Plan: read stock levels, create requests for items at their reorder point (quantity from the planning data, whole packs, supplier minimum)

title: Approval routing follows the rule table and the organisation
requirement: Rule 8 and the plan: a rule is chosen by value band, spend type, category, department and the date it is in force; its chain becomes real people

title: Sourcing picks the right contract price, or sends the line to quotation
requirement: Plan: contract vs RFQ per line; only an active contract in force, for an active supplier, in the right unit, with the quantity break

title: GST and order arithmetic is exact, to the paisa
requirement: Rule 1: money is Decimal to paise; GST splits into CGST+SGST within the state and IGST across states; composition and unregistered suppliers charge none

title: Quote comparison recommends the right supplier and the award rules hold
requirement: Plan: collect quotes, compare, award; the recommendation is the lowest compliant offer; an override or too few quotes needs a reason

title: The whole flow, stock level to approved purchase order, keeps its promises
requirement: Plan: nothing is lost, money reconciles, every change is audited, only eligible suppliers are asked, stock on the way is counted once

title: Repeating or racing any stage makes no duplicates
requirement: Plan: no duplicate requests, RFQs, emails or orders; document numbers have no gaps and no repeats

title: Decisions stay reproducible when the rules change
requirement: Rule 8: rules and rates are versioned data; a decision stays reproducible against the version it used

title: Every write action is open to exactly the roles the plan names
requirement: Rule 7 and the plan: requester, buyer, approver and administrator duties are separate; nobody else can do them; nobody can without logging in

title: One company cannot see another company's data
requirement: Rule 6: one database per tenant; a request without tenant context is refused; tenant A cannot read tenant B

title: Hostile text is shown as text and never run
requirement: Security: names from imported data and typed identifiers cannot inject script into the screens or SQL into the database

title: No floats in money, exact amounts on the wire, India's calendar, no secrets, synthetic data stays synthetic
requirement: Rules 1, 9, 10 and the generated-data safety rule

title: Supplier emails are read into the right quotes, and when unsure the system asks a person
requirement: Plan step 8 and rule 2: the model reads, code checks; a wrong reading must never look clean (silent errors = 0)
notes: the real models were not called (run with --live)

title: Hostile emails, even obeyed by the model, change nothing they should not
requirement: Security and rule 5: untrusted text cannot award, decline others, set a nonsense price, or reach a model from a stranger
notes: the real models were not called (run with --live)

title: The assistant tells the truth from the data, adds nothing up on its own, and changes nothing
requirement: Plan step 8 and rule 2: read-only tools; every figure it gives comes from a tool; it cannot approve or delete
notes: skipped: this eval needs the real models (run with --live)

title: Documents, budget, contract ceilings and reminders do what the plan says
requirement: Plan, phase 1 controls: a supplier needs good documents, a request must fit its budget, a contract has a ceiling, and a silent supplier is reminded a limited number of times

title: Orders are sent to the right supplier with the right amounts, only when approved, and acknowledged on time
requirement: Plan: an approved order goes to the supplier by email; nothing else does; the supplier's promised date is checked against the date the goods are needed; an order with no acknowledgement in two working days is overdue

title: Goods receipt: tolerance, rejections, inspection, stock and order progress are right
requirement: Plan: goods are received against a sent order; over-delivery is accepted up to the category's tolerance; rejected goods stay out of stock; items needing inspection wait; the order line and the stock follow what was accepted

title: Invoices are matched to orders and receipts the way the dataset's answers say
requirement: Plan P1-16/17: three-way match per line (quantity against accepted receipt, price within tolerance), tax and identity checks, duplicates caught, credit notes taken in; nothing is paid that the match blocks

title: Due dates and tax at source are worked out the way the dataset's answers say
requirement: Plan P1-19 (FR23, FR26): due date from the payment terms with the 45-day rule for micro and small suppliers; tax on goods (194Q) at booking on the part of a supplier's year above 50 lakh

title: Payments are for the right amounts, in the right order, once, and only for invoices that may be paid
requirement: Plan P1-19/20: due date and tax at booking, credit notes netted, MSME first, MSME interest, the run approved by a person, the file equal to the approved run, invoices paid once, the case closed on payment

title: Company setup is admin-only, logged, validated, and its locks cannot be undone
requirement: Plan P1-24 and rule 5/8: who approves, tolerances and automation are data an Admin changes with a reason; payment runs, vendor activation and releasing a payment block are never automatic; past decisions stay reproducible

title: Vendor scores follow how suppliers really behave, and planted repeat requests are caught
requirement: Plan P1-05 and the vendor choice: a supplier's score reflects its delivery, quality and price; the best-vendor mode is no worse than the cheapest; a request that repeats another is flagged and an ordinary one is not
notes: too little history for rank agreement to mean much: only the order of the profile means is required

title: Plain-words requests become the right drafts or one right question, and never a wrong draft
requirement: Plan P1-08 (AG01): at least 90% of lines mapped to the right item and quantity; every value traces to the message; an instruction hidden in a message is ignored; only drafts are made
notes: careful reader: action differs from the template:

title: Blocked invoices are explained with the right cause, and a block is never changed by the agent
requirement: Plan P1-18 (AG03): at least 80% of mismatch cases diagnosed correctly (proposed target); the payment block stays until a person releases it; numbers in the answer come from the data
notes: the real models were not called (run with --live)

title: Advances, early-payment discounts and the closing notice are right
requirement: Plan P1-19/20: 30% advance on an order and its adjustment against invoices (tax at source on the advance), a cash discount for paying inside the window, the requester told when the order is paid and closed

title: Invoices are read from documents correctly, e-invoices without a model, and a wrong reading never looks clean
requirement: Plan P1-16 (second half): >=95% of fields right on 30 invoices; QR invoices read with 0 model calls; silent errors 0; strangers' mail never reaches a model; automatic entry only when nothing is in doubt

title: Supplier emails are classified, small changes applied, the rest handed to a person, nothing wrong applied
requirement: Plan P1-14 (AG02): at least 90% of replies handled the right way; a change within the tolerance is applied, outside it goes to a buyer; a price change, a substitution or a bank change never changes anything; mail from outside the supplier is never read by a model; part deliveries and unacknowledged orders are chased
notes: the real models were not called (run with --live)

title: The control tower, the key figures and the alerts agree with an independent recount
requirement: Plan P1-21/P1-23: every role sees what needs it and nothing else; the control tower shows every case by stage, location and age in working days; the key figures reconcile with the raw data; alerts are raised once, routed by role, and resolved when their cause goes away
